name: DentoScan
description: DentoScan is a full-stack web application designed to analyze dental X-ray images. Users can upload various image formats, including DICOM, and the system uses machine learning (via Roboflow) to detect dental pathologies like cavities. It then generates a diagnostic report based on the findings, and the processed image with annotations is displayed

paragraphs: Build a full-stack web application that allows users to upload a Dental X-ray DICOM image, sends it to a Roboflow object detection model, displays bounding boxes for detected pathologies on the image, and passes the image + annotations to an LLM to generate a textual diagnostic report, which will be shown in a panel on the dashboard.
features: Upload and convert DICOM (.dcm or .rvg) images to viewable PNG/JPG format
Allow direct PNG/JPG/JPEG uploads for local testing and demo workflows
Display original and annotated images with bounding boxes showing pathology name and confidence
Pinch zoom feature toggles when clicking on the image for better inspection
Generate diagnostic reports using LLM based on image annotations
